# Zoomi

> Zoomi (Zoomi, LLC) is a design-led marketing company based in Indiana, USA. It designs brand identities, websites, and marketing campaigns, and manages search visibility with its own SEO software, Zoomi Audit.

## Services

- Brand identity: logo and identity systems, brand guidelines, messaging and voice.
- Websites: design and build, landing pages, technical SEO foundations.
- Campaigns and content: paid and social creative, email and print, launch campaigns.
- Strategy and growth: positioning, marketing roadmaps, analytics and reporting.

## Software

- [Zoomi Audit](https://audit.zoomi.co): SEO software that monitors site health, tracks keywords and rankings, and produces a prioritized list of fixes. It can be added to any Zoomi marketing engagement.

## Other Zoomi companies

- [Zoomi Government](https://gov.zoomi.co): government contracting and vendor fulfillment.
- [Margin](https://margin.zoomi.co): a Bible-reading app.
- [Zoomi Rentals](https://rent.zoomi.co): delivered and serviced washer and dryer rentals.
